name: Hohe Brücke
kurzbeschreibung:
**High Bridge in Mittersill**

Discover the **Hohe Brücke**, a historic wooden bridge spanning the **Ziller River** in the heart of **Mittersill**, a charming town in **Tirol**. Built in 1516, this architectural marvel connects the two halves of the village and offers breathtaking views of the surrounding **Kitzbühel Alps**.

A short walk from the **Hohe Brücke** leads you to the **Mittersill Town Hall** and the picturesque **Mittersiller Platz**, where you can enjoy a traditional **Tiroler Gröstl** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel** at one of the cozy cafés.

In winter, the bridge transforms into a magical ice sculpture, while summer brings vibrant festivals and outdoor concerts. Whether you're exploring on foot, by bike, or on skis, the **Hohe Brücke** is a must-see landmark in **Mittersill**.
